  r-base:

- linux-64

about.summary: Compared with the similar graph embedding method such as Laplacian Eigenmaps, 'Vicus' can exploit more local structures of graph data. For the details of the methods, see the reference section of 'GitHub' README.md <https://github.com/rikenbit/Vicus>.

Compared with the similar graph embedding method such as Laplacian Eigenmaps, 'Vicus' can exploit more local structures of graph data. For the details of the methods, see the reference section of 'GitHub' README.md <https://github.com/rikenbit/Vicus>.

name: r-vicus
raw_meta_yaml:
{% set version = '0.99.0' %}
{% set posix = 'm2-' if win else '' %}

package:
  name: r-vicus
  version: {{ version|replace("-", "_") }}

source:
  url:
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/Vicus_{{ version }}.tar.gz
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/Archive/Vicus/Vicus_{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 0400b5ea8f0d54d71db1a9c1df65c5abefb5607b99247bf7da40d747c6af9bb8

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: generic
  rpaths:
    - lib/R/lib/
    - lib/
  missing_dso_whitelist:
    - '*/R.dll'        # [win]
    - '*/Rblas.dll'    # [win]
    - '*/Rlapack.dll'  # [win]

requirements:
  build:
    - {{ posix }}zip               # [win]
    - cross-r-base {{ r_base }}    # [build_platform != target_platform]
  host:
    - r-base
    - r-matrix
    - r-rann
    - r-rspectra
  run:
    - r-base
    - r-matrix
    - r-rann
    - r-rspectra

test:
  commands:
    - $R -e "library('Vicus')"           # [not win]
    - "\"%R%\" -e \"library('Vicus')\""  # [win]

about:
  home: https://github.com/rikenbit/Vicus
  license: MIT
  summary: Compared with the similar graph embedding method such as Laplacian Eigenmaps, 'Vicus'
    can exploit more local structures of graph data. For the details of the methods,
    see the reference section of 'GitHub' README.md <https://github.com/rikenbit/Vicus>.
  license_family: MIT
  license_file:
    - '{{ environ["PREFIX"] }}/lib/R/share/licenses/MIT'
    - LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - conda-forge/r
